title: IncidentMonitorEvent
description: Translated event for the monitor intake — an observed condition on an entity, with no owner, no acknowledgment, and no deadline: the origin observes, it doesn't manage work. Published on the translated topic. See domain/ubiquitous-language.md#condition and docs/insights/fluxo-do-incidente.md.

event_id.description: Same identifier as the raw envelope this event was translated from.

version.description: Version of this translated contract — separate from dictionary_version, since the two change for different reasons.

dictionary_version.description: Version of the source's translation dictionary that produced this line. See domain/acl/itsm.md#o-dicionário-de-tradução.

condition.description: Translated by the origin's dictionary. 'cleared', not 'resolved' — resolved already means something else in the alert intake's lifecycle, and the same term with two meanings across intakes is a source of error.

entity_id.description: The only correlation key between the alert and monitor chains. See domain/ubiquitous-language.md#entity.
